name: Kinetra
summary: A black and neon gym staff app: drag-and-drop rota, swipe-to-approve time off and monthly payroll
about: A seven-page app for gyms, shops and any team that works in shifts, in black, chalk and neon lime. Plan the week on a rota you drag shifts around while clashes, hours and pay update, read a neon coverage pulse that shows where the floor is short, swipe time off requests to approve or decline them, and run monthly payroll from rota hours with payslips.
how: Pick a club (or both) in the top bar and open a page from the sidebar; on a phone use the menu button.
On Floor, watch the coverage pulse draw across the week; red bands are hours with fewer staff than needed. Hover for the numbers.
On Rota, drag shifts between people and days (Alt copies, M moves with the keyboard), click a slot to add one, then copy, auto-fill or publish.
On Requests, swipe the top card right to approve or left to decline, or use the buttons or arrow keys; undo from the toast.
On Payroll, adjust lines, approve the month, pay it out and open any payslip.
Settings change the rest rule, overtime limit and how many staff each part of the day needs; the pulse follows them.
